scenes.heading: Jobs in Korea, in English
scenes.say: This is a job board that shows every posting in Korea in English.
The home page is a single feed, collected from many Korean job boards.
It is the same feed on a phone.

scenes.text: Every title is shown in English.
scenes.say: Every job title is shown in English, whatever language it was posted in.
